raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The GLM-5.3-Flash H200 test runs High Throughput and Low Latency recipes in one process, sharing the default 1200-second per-file CI budget. In [this failure on #44220](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38998797308/job/117297505340), High Throughput completed GSM8K with 97.12% accuracy, but the file timed out during the Low Latency evaluation.

## Modifications

Split the recipes into independently registered test files, each with an estimated duration of 1200 seconds. Each gets its own existing per-file timeout and can be partitioned separately. Move the unchanged server setup and cleanup into a shared helper. Preserve all model arguments, accuracy thresholds, speculative acceptance checks, and decode performance checks.

## Validation

- AST comparison confirms every original class, function, and constant is preserved exactly once.
- The CI collector discovers both executable CUDA tests in `extra-b-test-8-gpu-h200`; partitioning treats them independently.
- Python syntax, isort, Ruff lint, Ruff formatting, and whitespace checks pass. All commit-time pre-commit hooks pass.
- [H200 validation](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39032680509/job/117396243462) passed on commit `66fcf904f261d2ece679de80c3fdb2d8b95b7ca6`, triggered with `/rerun-test` without adding CI labels. Both files finished below the ordinary suite's 1200-second per-file budget:

| Recipe | File wall time (including setup/cleanup) | GSM8K | Result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| High Throughput | 569 s | 97.19% | Passed |
| Low Latency | 314 s | 97.12% | Passed |

The files ran sequentially in one rerun job (883 s total). The rerun workflow does not enforce the ordinary suite's per-file timeout, so the measured file wall times were checked explicitly. This is one successful run on an 8-H200 runner; it does not establish a worst-case cold-start bound.

## Accuracy Tests

Both recipes passed the unchanged full 1319-example GSM8K check and 0.96 accuracy threshold (results above).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Low Latency passed `test_bs_1_speed` on its first attempt: acceptance length 4.478 > 4.0 and speed 343.75 token/s > 200. All three unittest methods across the two files passed.

+"""Shared server setup for the GLM-5.3-Flash H200 serving recipes."""
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    _wait_for_gpu_idle_in_ci,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    try_cached_model,
+)
+
+MODEL_PATH = "zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash"
+SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT = 3600
+GPU_IDLE_TIMEOUT = 120
+
+COMMON_SERVER_ARGS = [
+    "--tp-size",
+    "8",
+    "--dsa-prefill-backend",
+    "tilelang",
+    "--dsa-decode-backend",
+    "tilelang",
+    "--kv-cache-dtype",
+    "bf16",
+    "--moe-runner-backend",
+    "deep_gemm",
+    "--reasoning-parser",
+    "auto",
+    "--tool-call-parser",
+    "auto",
+]
+
+
+def _stop_server(process):
+    if process:
+        kill_process_tree(process.pid)
+        _wait_for_gpu_idle_in_ci(timeout=GPU_IDLE_TIMEOUT)
+
+
+class _GLM53FlashH200Base(CustomTestCase):
+    server_args: list[str]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = try_cached_model(MODEL_PATH)
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls.process = None
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT,
+            other_args=cls.server_args,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        _stop_server(getattr(cls, "process", None))

+"""H200 per-commit coverage for the GLM-5.3-Flash high throughput recipe."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.glm53_flash_common import COMMON_SERVER_ARGS, _GLM53FlashH200Base
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=1200, stage="extra-b", runner_config="8-gpu-h200")
+
+
+class TestGLM53FlashH200HighThroughput(
+    GSM8KMixin,
+    _GLM53FlashH200Base,
+):
+    gsm8k_score_threshold = 0.96
+    gsm8k_num_examples = 1319
+    gsm8k_num_threads = 256

+    gsm8k_thinking = True
+    gsm8k_max_tokens = 8192
+    gsm8k_temperature = 1.0
+    gsm8k_top_p = 0.95
+    server_args = [
+        *COMMON_SERVER_ARGS,
+        "--attn-dp-size",
+        "8",
+        "--mm-enable-dp-encoder",
+    ]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""H200 per-commit coverage for the GLM-5.3-Flash low latency recipe."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.glm53_flash_common import COMMON_SERVER_ARGS, _GLM53FlashH200Base
+from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
+from sglang.test.kits.spec_decoding_kit import SpecDecodingMixin
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=1200, stage="extra-b", runner_config="8-gpu-h200")
+
+
+class TestGLM53FlashH200LowLatency(
+    SpecDecodingMixin,
+    GSM8KMixin,
+    _GLM53FlashH200Base,
+):
+    gsm8k_score_threshold = 0.96
+    gsm8k_num_examples = 1319
+    gsm8k_num_threads = 256
+    gsm8k_backend = "sgl_eval"
+    gsm8k_thinking = True
+    gsm8k_max_tokens = 8192
+    gsm8k_temperature = 1.0
+    gsm8k_top_p = 0.95
+    accept_length_thres = 4.0
+    bs_1_speed_thres = 200
+    server_args = [
+        *COMMON_SERVER_ARGS,
+        "--speculative-algorithm",
+        "EAGLE",
+        "--speculative-num-steps",
+        "5",
+        "--speculative-eagle-topk",
+        "1",
+        "--speculative-num-draft-tokens",
+        "6",
+    ]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
